conventions.transport: MCP over stdio, newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0; tools/call result.content[0].text carries the result.
conventions.result_text: For every tool the text is a JSON object matching result, except that note_prompt and skill_started may return empty text, which counts as {}.
conventions.validation: input and result are JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 subset: type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minimum, minLength, maxProperties, pattern, oneOf, dependentRequired, $ref to #/$defs). contract/check_contract.py checks them with a stdlib validator.
conventions.ids: Item ids match ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}$. Statuses are capitalised (Open, Resolved, Parked, Stale); the items counts in status use lower-case keys.
conventions.unknown_arguments: Input schemas set additionalProperties false: an unknown argument is an error, so a model-facing tool cannot be handed a session id.
conventions.errors: Every domain failure (invalid arguments, refused transition, unknown id, rule violation, wrong state, unfinished journal, mismatch, _meta rejection) is a tools/call result with isError true and a single text content item holding a plain-text message that contains the substrings named in the errors table; it is never a JSON-RPC error. JSON-RPC errors are only for a malformed protocol request (unparseable JSON, unknown method, unknown tool name, malformed params envelope). A failing call changes no state and writes no journal event.
conventions.no_effect_on_error: A call that returns an error changes nothing: it does not start an interview, engage a pending one, return a complete one to active, change a counter or cap, or write a journal event. Hook-facing calls that are rejected (row 2 or 3) do not record last_seen_session_id or count as hook calls.

begin_interview.description: Register-mode start by the skill after its status probe (REQ-21). No session id: binds to last_seen_session_id (REQ-27 rule 1). In state none it starts an interview into active (existing false). In state pending it engages it: pending becomes active, the id of the pending interview is returned, existing true (REQ-27 rule 3). In active or complete it is a no-op returning the existing id with the unchanged state and existing true; it does not return a complete interview to active (REQ-22, REQ-27). Refused while an unfinished journal exists (REQ-52). Error on tool_schema mismatch names both values (REQ-77).

log_item.description: Log an item. id is an optional caller-supplied label (kept from spike 3); the server assigns one if absent. depends_on ids must already exist. A subquestion requires parent. answer, source and rationale together record a decision the user volunteered (REQ-32); source user is subject to the per-prompt rule.

resolve.description: Resolve an Open, Stale or Parked item (REQ-38). answer, source and rationale are all required (REQ-31). source user needs a user prompt since the item's last model action (REQ-32); a decision item takes source user only (REQ-34).

park.description: Park an Open, Stale or model-Parked item (REQ-38). parked_by user is subject to the user-prompt rule (REQ-33); a decision item is parked by user only (REQ-34).

reopen.description: Reopen a Resolved item (REQ-36): it becomes Open and every Resolved item depending on it, directly or transitively, becomes Stale; the result lists those ids in stale. Error if the item is not Resolved.

status.description: Probe and recovery. Reports server_version, tool_schema, lifecycle state (none, pending, active or complete; after an interview ends the state is none, never ended), the full tree (open items first, REQ-45), counts, hook-health counts, last event number, resumable, and any recorded version mismatch (REQ-77). Never engages a pending interview and never starts one. journal_schema is kept from spike 3 (A7). The items counts must equal the counts derived from tree by status (Open, Resolved, Parked, Stale); check_contract.py checks this on every good example and C2 scenarios assert it.

resume.description: Resume an unfinished journal (REQ-52): accepted only in state none or pending; rebinds to last_seen_session_id; claims the pid file exclusively. id may be omitted when exactly one unfinished journal exists; when several exist the error lists them. Replay failure names the 1-based line number and leaves state unchanged (REQ-60). The result state is always active (a journal whose last events include complete replays to active; the complete state is not restored). Not a start-engaging call.

discard.description: Archive an unfinished journal and continue plain (REQ-52). id may be omitted when exactly one unfinished journal exists.

end_interview.description: End the interview (REQ-23). Refused while items are open unless abandon is true with a non-blank reason. end_kind: normal = active, nothing open; ended_incomplete_by_model = abandon true with a reason while items are open; ended_after_completion = complete interview; stood_down = mode plain on a pending interview. The journal-only kinds abandoned (session change) and the log-only kind interrupted are never returned by this tool. mode plain stands a pending interview down without flagging it incomplete (REQ-27 rule 3). The result state is the const ended (the transition just made); a later status reports none. Not a start-engaging call.

note_prompt.description: UserPromptSubmit hook: counts a user prompt and records last_seen_session_id, even when no interview is active (REQ-13, REQ-27). Rejects any call carrying _meta claudecode/toolUseId. Returns empty text or exactly {} (REQ-41).

skill_started.description: UserPromptExpansion and PreToolUse(Skill) hooks: a skill name exactly matching the configured list starts a pending interview (REQ-20, REQ-24). Never blocks or denies; on a tool_schema mismatch returns {} and records the mismatch for status (REQ-77). Rejects _meta claudecode/toolUseId. Returns empty text or exactly {}.

check_stop.description: Stop hook: records last_seen_session_id, classifies the turn and applies the finish gate (REQ-42, REQ-43). Returns {} to allow or a block decision whose reason names the open items (first 10, text truncated to 120 characters, REQ-45). Rejects _meta claudecode/toolUseId. Fails open.

errors.message_names: unfinished journal: call resume or discard
the item id and its current status

errors.when: depends_on or parent names a missing item
decision item with source model; or REQ-35 parent with fewer than N children and source model
source or parked_by user without a user prompt since the budget point
errors.message_names: a message saying so; when no prompt hook call was ever seen, a message saying hooks are not firing (REQ-44)

errors.when: a caller-supplied id is already used by an item in this interview
errors.message_names: the duplicate id, e.g. "duplicate id: q1"; nothing is logged and no journal event is written

errors.when: items open without abandon true and a reason
journal already claimed; several unfinished journals and no id; state not none or pending; replay failure
errors.message_names: journal already claimed | the list of interview ids | the state | the 1-based line number as a digit string

error_precedence: Protocol: unparseable JSON, unknown method or unknown tool name is a JSON-RPC error (the only non-isError failures).
Hook-facing tools only: a call carrying _meta claudecode/toolUseId is rejected (isError, row 'call carries _meta').
Argument validation against the tool's input schema, including unknown arguments and cross-field dependencies (isError, message starts 'invalid arguments:' and names the parameter).
begin_interview only: tool_schema differs from the server's (message names both values).

Unfinished journal: begin_interview, log_item, resolve, park and reopen are refused while an unfinished journal exists and the server is in state none or pending (message 'unfinished journal: call resume or discard').

Wrong lifecycle state or nothing to act on, per state_matrix (resume and discard in active/complete; end_interview in none, pending without mode plain, mode plain outside pending, abandon with nothing open; no unfinished journal / unknown id / live owner for resume and discard).

Item lookup: unknown id for resolve, park, reopen, or missing parent / depends_on for log_item (message 'no such item: <id>' or 'missing item: <id>'); duplicate caller id for log_item; subquestion without parent.
Transition table (REQ-38): transition not allowed for the item's current status.
Kind rules: decision item with source model or parked_by model (REQ-34); under-sized parent resolved by model (REQ-35).
User-prompt rules: hooks not firing (REQ-44), no user prompt since the budget point, per-prompt budget spent, volunteered-answer cap reached (REQ-32, REQ-33).
Open items without abandon true and a reason (end_interview only; checked after row 6 so a wrong state is reported first).

begin_interview.none: result: starts an interview into active, existing false; the skill value is recorded unvalidated (an unlisted skill name is accepted)
begin_interview.pending: result: engages the pending interview into active, existing true (REQ-27 rule 3)
begin_interview.active: result: no-op, state active, existing true
begin_interview.complete: result: no-op, state complete (does not return to active), existing true

log_item.none: result: implicit start into active (route implicit), item logged; rule errors leave state none
log_item.pending: result: engages into active, item logged
log_item.complete: result: item logged and the interview returns to active

resolve.none: error: no such item (the register is empty); does not start an interview
resolve.pending: error: no such item (a pending interview holds no items); does not engage
resolve.active: result: transition applied, or the error rows for unknown id, transition, kind and prompt rules
resolve.complete: result: transition applied and the interview returns to active; any error leaves it complete

park.none: error: no such item (the register is empty); does not start an interview
park.pending: error: no such item (a pending interview holds no items); does not engage
park.active: result: transition applied, or the error rows for unknown id, transition, kind and prompt rules
park.complete: result: transition applied and the interview returns to active; any error leaves it complete

reopen.none: error: no such item (the register is empty); does not start an interview
reopen.pending: error: no such item (a pending interview holds no items); does not engage
reopen.active: result: transition applied, or the error rows for unknown id, transition, kind and prompt rules
reopen.complete: result: transition applied and the interview returns to active; any error leaves it complete

status.none: result: state none; never starts an interview
status.pending: result: state pending; does not engage
status.complete: result: state complete; does not return it to active

resume.none: result: replays the journal and claims it, state active; errors: no unfinished journal, unknown id, live owner, several and no id, replay failure, journal already claimed
resume.pending: result: as none; the pending interview is replaced (ended as stood_down, not_engaged) only after the resume succeeded

discard.none: result: archives the named (or only) unfinished journal; state stays none; errors: no unfinished journal, unknown id, live owner, several and no id
discard.pending: result: as none; the pending interview stays pending

end_interview.pending: with mode plain and no abandon/reason: result stood_down; otherwise error (pending interview: use mode plain)
end_interview.active: nothing open and no abandon: result normal; open items without abandon: error naming them; abandon true with reason and items open: result ended_incomplete_by_model; abandon true with nothing open: error; mode plain: error
end_interview.complete: no abandon: result ended_after_completion; abandon: error (nothing open); mode plain: error

note_prompt.none: result {}: records last_seen_session_id (and prompt_seen for note_prompt); skill_started with a listed name starts a pending interview
note_prompt.pending: result {}: counted in hook_health; skill_started is a no-op returning the existing interview

skill_started.none: result {}: records last_seen_session_id (and prompt_seen for note_prompt); skill_started with a listed name starts a pending interview
skill_started.pending: result {}: counted in hook_health; skill_started is a no-op returning the existing interview

check_stop.pending: result {}: allows; the second check stands the interview down
check_stop.active: result {} or a block decision (REQ-42, REQ-43)
